title:
Microsoft Teams: Multiple screen shares
in Teams Rooms on Windows
description: You can now view up to two shared screens side by side during meetings, reducing interruptions from screen hand-offs. Participants can switch between side-by-side and expanded views, identify presenters for each screen, and benefit from layouts optimized for single or dual displays. Available with Teams Rooms Pro.
